scope: Actual baseline/candidate TileLayer.update source on fresh native tile-layer instances sharing the published exact geometry/material/generator/terrain/habitat. Native camera follows 120 fence-route targets, then holds a settled position for 120 updates, then relocates 80m and exercises pending reserve work for 121 updates.
